name: 1. [lab_4] - Dinosaur
sql:
SELECT *
FROM dinosaur
WHERE weight < 500
ORDER BY species;

name: 2. [lab_4] - Dinosaur-food
sql:
SELECT
 d.id,
 d.name,
 d.species,
 f.id,
 f.composition,
 f.species,
 f.price
FROM dinosaur d
JOIN food_dinosaur fd ON d.id = fd.dinosaur_id
JOIN food f ON fd.food_id = f.id
ORDER BY d.id DESC;

name: 3. [lab_4] - Exhibit
sql:
SELECT *
FROM exhibit
WHERE date < '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY name;

name: 4. [lab_4] - Tour-visitor
sql:
SELECT *
FROM tour
JOIN visitor ON visitor.id = tour.visitor_id
WHERE tour.price > '35Br'
ORDER BY price;

name: 5. [lab_4] - Visitor
sql:
SELECT *
FROM visitor v
WHERE v.age > 35 AND v.gender = 'Мужской'
ORDER BY v.age;

name: 6. [lab_4] - Enclosure
sql:
SELECT *
FROM enclosure
WHERE height >= 10
ORDER BY square;

name: 7. [lab_4] - Enclosure_employee
sql:
SELECT
 enc.id,
 enc.square,
 enc.location,
 enc.height,
 enc.capacity,
 emp.id,
 emp.name,
 emp.position
FROM enclosure enc
JOIN enclosure_employee ee ON ee.enclosure_id = enc.id
JOIN employee emp ON emp.id = ee.employee_id
WHERE capacity >= 5 AND capacity <= 12
ORDER BY emp.name;

name: 8. [lab_4] - Employee
sql:
SELECT *
FROM employee
WHERE gender = 'Женский' AND experience < 8
ORDER BY name DESC;

name: 9. [lab_4] - Exhibit_tour
sql:
SELECT
 ex.id,
 ex.name,
 ex.description,
 t.id,
 t.date,
 t.time,
 t.price
FROM exhibit ex
JOIN tour_exhibit te ON te.exhibit_id = ex.id
JOIN tour t ON t.id = te.tour_id
WHERE ex.name LIKE 'Окаменелость%'
ORDER BY ex.name;

name: 10. [lab_4] - Food
sql:
SELECT *
FROM food
WHERE price < '9Br' AND amount > 60
ORDER BY composition;

name: 11. [lab_4] - Dinosaur_enclosure
sql:
SELECT
 d.id,
 d.name,
 d.species,
 en.capacity,
 en.location,
 en.square
FROM dinosaur d
JOIN enclosure en ON en.id = d.enclosure_id
WHERE d.height > 4
ORDER BY d.name;

name: 12. [lab_4] - Food_with_meat
sql:
SELECT *
FROM food
WHERE species LIKE '%мясо%' OR species LIKE 'Мясо%'
ORDER BY price;

name: 1. [lab_5] - Dinosaur
sql:
SELECT
species,
COUNT(*) as count,
AVG(weight) as avg_weight,
AVG(height) as avg_height
FROM dinosaur
GROUP BY species
ORDER BY count DESC;

name: 2. [lab_5] - Dinosaur_male_speed
sql:
SELECT d.name, d.species, d.max_speed
FROM dinosaur d
WHERE d.max_speed > (
SELECT AVG(max_speed)
FROM dinosaur d2
WHERE d2.gender = 'Мужской'
);

name: 3. [lab_5] - Employee_experience
sql:
SELECT name, position, experience
FROM employee
WHERE experience > (SELECT AVG(experience) FROM employee)
ORDER BY experience DESC;

name: 4. [lab_5] - Employee_count_by_position
5. [lab_5] - Enclosure_count_average_area
sql:
SELECT
location,
COUNT(*) as enclosure_count,
AVG(square) as avg_square
FROM enclosure
GROUP BY location
ORDER BY enclosure_count DESC;

name: 6. [lab_5] - Enclosure_dinosaur_count
sql:
SELECT
 e.id,
 e.location,
 e.capacity,
 COUNT(d.id) as dinosaur_count
FROM enclosure e
LEFT JOIN dinosaur d ON e.id = d.enclosure_id
GROUP BY e.id, e.capacity
HAVING COUNT(d.id) > 0
ORDER BY dinosaur_count DESC;

name: 7. [lab_5] - Exhibit_statistics
sql:
SELECT
 EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
 COUNT(*) AS exhibits_per_year
FROM exhibit
WHERE date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY year DESC;

name: 8. [lab_5] - Visitor_age_statistics
sql:
SELECT
 CASE
 WHEN age < 18 THEN 'Дети'
 WHEN age BETWEEN 18 AND 30 THEN 'Молодежь'
 WHEN age BETWEEN 31 AND 50 THEN 'Взрослые'
 ELSE 'Пожилые'
 END as age_group,
 COUNT(*) as count
FROM visitor
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY count DESC;

name: 9. [lab_5] - Visitor_tour_count
sql:
SELECT v.name,
(SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM tour t
WHERE t.visitor_id = v.id) as tour_count
FROM visitor v
ORDER BY tour_count DESC;

name: 10. [lab_5] - Food_average_price
sql:
SELECT
 f.species,
 COUNT(DISTINCT fd.dinosaur_id) as dinosaur_count,
 AVG(f.price::numeric) as avg_price
FROM food f
LEFT JOIN food_dinosaur fd ON f.id = fd.food_id
GROUP BY f.species
ORDER BY dinosaur_count DESC;

name: 11. [lab_5] - Food_for_dinosaur
sql:
SELECT f.composition, f.price
FROM food f
WHERE f.id IN (
SELECT fd.food_id
FROM food_dinosaur fd
JOIN dinosaur d ON fd.dinosaur_id = d.id
WHERE d.species = 'Тиранозавр'
);

name: 12. [lab_5] - Tour_grouping_by_date
sql:
SELECT
 date,
 COUNT(*) as tour_count,
 AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM duration)/60) as avg_duration_minutes
FROM tour
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
